entries.mechanism: Each low-income pre-2020 Walloon child residual equals the 2025-indexed Walloon Decree Article 13 low-income monthly social supplement, annualized. The statutory base is 55 EUR/month (Walloon decree of 8 February 2018, Article 13, be-wal/statutes/family_benefits/amounts.yaml); the applied 2025 amount is 68.39 EUR/month at pivot index 130.67 from the AVIQ February 2025 amount table (be/statutes/family_benefits/child_benefit_base_2025.yaml). EUROMOD BE_2025 cumulates this indexed supplement on top of the LGAF transition amounts for pre-2020 children, contrary to Walloon Articles 120, 123, and 128; the age-0 new-system control cases match exactly.

Each middle-income pre-2020 Walloon child residual equals the 2025-indexed Walloon Decree Article 13 middle-income monthly social supplement, annualized. The statutory base is 25 EUR/month; the applied 2025 amount is 31.09 EUR/month from the AVIQ February 2025 amount table. Same EUROMOD BE_2025 pre-2020 cumulation mechanism as the low-income cases; the age-0 control case matches exactly.
